description.value: Train Wreck Brewing is a craft brewery and taproom that opened in Port Moody in 2024, producing unfiltered, full-flavoured beers — from hazy IPAs and hefeweizens to Belgian dubbels and dry Irish stouts — using time-honoured techniques and quality local ingredients. The sprawling yet intimate taproom doubles as an event venue with daily food vendors, bar games, and live music, making it a genuine community gathering place. The brewery also offers behind-the-scenes tours, adding an educational dimension for curious visitors.
